_readme: S395 SkyHawthorn, 2026-10-15. 117 of Monterey Peninsula's 199 records fail the arithmetic check: 65 name the degree total and the GE pattern (MPC General Education or Cal-GETC, 42; Cal-GETC alone, 23) with no GE units, and 47 sum their blocks unequal to the stated total by a half unit or a unit. Before writing its reconcile steps (kb/program_requirements_reconcile.json; Sam, 2026-10-14), this read prints how a degree page and a transfer degree page state the GE units and the degree total, and how a certificate page states the total its blocks miss by a half unit. Three loads, no model call.

questions.block_sum: How the page prints the total its blocks miss by a half unit or a unit (a range, a footnote, a choice).
questions.degree_total: Whether and how the page prints the degree total (60), apart from the major's total.
questions.ge_line: Whether and how the page prints the general education units for the degree, and which pattern.
